crossRefs.note: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
“For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.
Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to Yahweh their God’s voice, nor received instruction.…
She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be…
We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

translations.web: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
translations.bsb: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
translations.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that ➔ we should ➔ not be condemned with the world.
translations.asv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
